fullPassage: Dear Homeowner / Resident: Beginning around mid-April, 2017, contractors for the City of Southfield will perform water main and pavement replacement in your area. Consumers Energy will also perform selective gas service renewal as part of the work. A map is attached to this letter which shows areas of water main replacement and road replacement.
